airframe.name: Minimag
airframe.description:
Basic Fixedwing airframe equipped with a PX4 Pixracer flightcontroller hardware.
Lots of comments to make it easy to re-use this airframe as a starting point for your own airframe.
+ MODEL: Multiplex Minimag + FC: PX4 FMU 4.0 in the form of a Pixracer v1.0 R15 + ACTUATORS: Regular metal gear 9g servos + GNSS: uBlox M10N GNSS + MAG: IST8310 Magnetometer + ESC: CastleCreations Phoenix 35 + RCRX: OpenRXSR Receiver + AIRSPEED: Eagletree Airspeed v3 + TELEMETRY: Si10xx Chip based with SiK FlexFreq firmware + CURRENT: A standard V/I clone of 3DR PowerBrick + RANGEFINDER: MAXBOTICS XL-MaxSonar-AE4 MB1340 analog Ultrasonic sensor + MOTOR: 1300kV Brushless motor + PROP: 3 Blade 7in x 4.5in Left
NOTES: + Some clone Pixracers R15 have an MPU6500 instead of MPU9250, use the mpu6000 module in that case + Using Enhanced Total Energy control as control loop in Final AC if wanted + Servo pins point to FRONT of airframe + External IST8310 Magnetometer on GNSS device PCB can be used for better heading estimate + Airframe with removed fixed landing gear + Ultrasonic sensor output analog datapin is connected to RSSI pin + Horizontal stabilizer removable modification for easier in box transport + FC is rotated sideways 90 degrees counterclockwise, so SDcard and USB connector point upwards + Engine battery voltage and current values via separate sensor + Servos and Analog Rangefinder powered via BEC of the ESC + Flightcontroller powered via BEC on powerbrick + Uploading of the firmware can be performed via original PX4 bootloader... Simple, Press UPLOAD, then USB cable in, wait... voila PPRZ software on a Pixracer... + A GNSS device with yet ANOTHER magneto on it is used, externally... + On I2C we have airspeed sensor and external magneto via a I2C split + Separated aileron servo outputs pins for possible flapperon (down) spoileron (up) braking precision landings + GNSS set to ~10Hz update rate, 3 constellations, SBAS enabled + Default battery for this airframe is a 5500mAh 3S LiIon INR21700-M58T 12C ++ Alternative battery for this airframe could be a 2200mAh 3S LiPo 15C + Make sure to set the correct CutOff value in your ESC if flying Li-Ion pack + Using Enhanced Total Energy control as control loop in Final AC
If testing "Classic" (as in not ETECS..) make sure to disable the settings/estimation/ac_char Set the USE_AIRSPEED value to FALSE at first, for no airspeed tests Use also flightplan_versatile if no airspeed sensor is ues and use flightplan versatile_unified only with enabled airspeed sensor
